findings.explanation: The client can end the contract immediately at any time without paying you for completed work, while you lack a corresponding right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client upon delivery, before you are paid in full.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of updates before I sign. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the agreement currently allows the client to end the contract immediately without notice or payment for completed work, and I propose that either party may terminate the agreement for convenience upon thirty days prior written notice, with the client paying for all services performed up to the date of termination. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, the current terms transfer ownership of the work upon delivery rather than after payment, and I propose that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable shall transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for such deliverable. Thank you for your flexibility, and I look forward to working together.
